constants.py.notes: Four-way split: FIT 2010-01-01..2020-12-31, TUNE 2021-01-01..2022-06-30, TEST 2022-07-01..2023-06-30, RESERVE 2023-07-01..2023-12-31 (replacement TEST if Stage 8 fails), HOLDOUT 2024-01-01+ (permanently fixed). DATA_START moved 2012-12-01 -> 2010-01-01 when TML data replaced tennis-data.co.uk; holdout cutoff unchanged. Split assigned by tourney_date (tournament start).

rules.py.notes: Documented entries: 4 majors (full rule histories), Tour Finals, Olympics, Next Gen (short sets, supported=False). Everything else inferred per (tourney_code, season) from deciding-set score patterns: 3,807 tournament-year entries, 70 inferred as advantage. Inference independently recovers the documented advantage eras at RG/Wimbledon/AO. Empirical scan: 16 conflicts in 96,804 completed matches (0.017%), all Davis Cup ties (per-tie ids give almost no inference evidence); all flagged score_string_suspect. review_candidates() = 0 tournament-years above the 3%/30-match manual-review threshold, so the rules.py human checkpoint does not trigger. 15/15 tests pass incl. Isner-Mahut 70-68 legal under its assigned rules.

stage_0.notes: REDONE on TML-Database (vendor/). 100,658 matches 2010-01-03..2023-11-27, 39,596 ATP + 61,062 Challenger; 2024-2026 files never opened. Outcomes: completed 96,804 / retired 3,342 / walkover 502 / default 9 / unknown 1 (parsed from score-string RET/W-O/DEF markers - TML has no flag column). score_string_suspect 285 rows (0.28%). serve_stats_valid 92.2%. 105 tournament codes change surface. 62 rows had colliding ids (TML 'Rome'/'GA' field swap) - match_id now includes season. 24/24 tests pass. SCOPE DECISION (human, 2026-07-30): Davis Cup, Olympics, Tour Finals and Next Gen excluded via in_scope=False (4,041 rows); 96,617 in scope (35,555 ATP + 61,062 Challenger). Retirement policy confirmed as documented: retired excluded from rate/venue/correction fitting, included in Elo as win/loss; walkover and default update nothing.

stage_1.notes: engine.py closed form + simulate.py point-level MC. 55 gate tests pass: p_hold(0.5)==0.5 exactly, p_hold monotonic over p in (0.01,0.99), p_hold and p_tiebreak (7- and 10-point) match state-expansion enumeration to 1e-12 at 6 and 8 (pa,pb) points respectively; match distribution matches 70k-match point-level MC (>=1e7 points) within 4 SE on P(A), mean total games and P(any tiebreak) for all five format variants (advantage bo5, 12-12 TB bo5, 10-pt TB bo5, 7-pt TB bo5, 7-pt TB bo3) at two (pa,pb) pairs; symmetry p_match(a,b)+p_match(b,a)==1 and mirrored joint games distribution; advantage-set truncated mass ~1e-11 < TAIL_MASS_THRESHOLD 1e-9; ladder monotone; over+under+push==1; suspect-flagged matches excluded from validation targets. No hyperparameter fitted, so no ledger entry.

stage_2.notes: Selected on TUNE: half-life 730d, surface pooling 300 serve points, shrinkage n0 500 serve points (4x4x4 grid). GATE PASSED on both required comparisons: next-match serve-points-won MAE 0.06595 vs career-average 0.06834 and last-10 0.07004; match-winner log-loss through the Stage 1 engine 0.67106 vs 0.71706 and 0.74711. n=21,244 player-matches on TUNE. FIT-internal rolling-origin gain over career average: +0.00111/+0.00107/+0.00098/+0.00102/+0.00124 (mean +0.00108, std 0.00010); TUNE gain +0.00071 - BELOW the FIT gain, so no overfit signal. Opponent adjustment converged within 50 sweeps at 1e-6 with the level-period average serve-win% as the identifiability anchor. Ledger entry frozen. NOTE: serve_stats_valid now also excludes score_string_suspect rows (ground rule 8) - found by a test, fixed, dataset rebuilt (91,242 usable rows).

stage_3.notes: Surface Elo. Selected on TUNE (144-setting grid): K=48, Challenger K x0.75, surface blend 0.3, inactivity half-life 1095d, new-player level gap 100, cross-level offset 0. GATE PASSED: decile calibration max |gap| 0.0170 and mean |gap| 0.0085 against pre-set criteria 0.05/0.025; Brier 0.22483 vs rankings-baseline 0.22993 (log-loss 0.63977 vs 0.65107) on 11,225 TUNE matches. CROSS-LEVEL CHECK reported: Challenger-built vs tour-rated, n=2,883, predicted 0.4243 vs observed 0.4131, gap -0.0112 = 1.2 SE, within noise, so no level offset fitted. FIT rolling-origin gain mean +0.00833 std 0.00268, TUNE gain +0.01130, excess 0.00297 < envelope 0.00536 - no overfit signal. Ledger frozen.

stage_4.notes: Blend of serve gap and Elo gap; level taken from Stage 2, split blended. Elo win prob converted to a serve gap by inverting the Stage 1 engine on a 26x81 (level,gap) grid, round-tripped to 0.01 in tests. GATE PASSED: per-bucket w TUNE log-loss 0.63470 vs w=0 0.67107 and w=1 0.63655 on 10,622 TUNE matches. Selected w: overall 0.80; both-well-sampled 0.80, one-thin 0.85, both-thin 0.90 (thin threshold 1000 effective serve points) - thin data wants more Elo, as the spec expected. Disagreement metadata: mean abs 11.64pp, p90 24.50pp, 47.5% of matches above 10pp; carried out per match, not absorbed. FIT rolling-origin gain mean +0.00243 std 0.00097, TUNE gain +0.00185 - below FIT gain, no overfit signal.

stage_5.notes: Cohort kNN prior replaces the flat tour-average prior for thin players. Style vector: ace rate, DF rate, serve pw, return pw, clay lean, hand, height; features AND standardization stats both as-of the 91-day snapshot (test asserts truncating the future leaves earlier snapshots bit-identical). GATE PASSED on both required metrics, TUNE thin-data matches only (n=3,199): match-winner log-loss 0.63883 vs tour-average 0.63939; total-games CRPS 3.7113 vs 3.7191. Selected k=5. The opponent-vs-cohort adjustment is implemented and measured: it improves CRPS (3.7025) but costs log-loss (0.64043), and selection is on log-loss, so it ships OFF (opponent_vs_cohort_n0=0). Grid in the report shows the trade. FIT rolling-origin gain mean +0.00120 std 0.00038, TUNE gain +0.00056 - below FIT gain, no overfit signal.
